role: Primary large-scale long-term memory and reasoning evaluation. Larger-scale long-horizon memory QA; used for the same pipeline as LoCoMo but at greater memory-store scale, stressing candidate-generation recall at higher corpus sizes. (Quoted/paraphrased from phase3/specification/DATASET_CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md section 2.2.)

registry_reference.record_count_reference: data/metadata/phase2_freeze_manifest.json: memory_foundation.record_counts.longmemeval = 210365 (matches the actual line count of data/processed/longmemeval/memory_records.jsonl, verified in this stage).

inspection_method.description: Read-only inspection performed in Phase 3.2-G: first 2 lines of memory_records.jsonl read in full for field-shape confirmation; a deterministic 500-line prefix sample of memory_records.jsonl checked programmatically for memory_id uniqueness; a deterministic 300-line prefix sample of task_records.jsonl checked programmatically for answer/evidence_memory_ids null/empty rates (0/300 null or empty found in this sample); the full memory_records.jsonl file (all 210365 lines) was grep-searched (not fully re-read record-by-record) for the literal field names parent_ids/equivalent_to/conflicts_with/superseded_by, with zero matches. All other claims are sample-based, not exhaustive; a corpus this size (210365 memory records) was never read in full.

stable_id.reason: Sampled records carry a `memory_id` field (24-hex-char identifier), same shape/convention as LoCoMo's.

unique_id.reason: 500/500 sampled memory_id values were unique in the prefix sample.

content_available.reason: Sampled records have non-empty `content` strings (both user and assistant turns observed in the 2-line sample).

session_linked.reason: Sampled records carry `session_id` and `conversation_id` (both set to the same haystack-session-style string in the sample, e.g. 'answer_4be1b6b4_2').

typed_foundation_or_derived.reason: No explicit foundation/derived type tag exists in the file; per phase3/schemas/memory_schema.md, records sourced from the frozen Phase 1/2 UMR substrate are foundation memories by construction, but this is not asserted by an explicit field.

explicit_parent_ids_present.reason: Whole-file grep of all 210365 lines for the literal string 'parent_ids' returned zero matches.

explicit_task_records.reason: data/processed/longmemeval/task_records.jsonl exists with 1000 records, each with a `task_id` distinct from any `memory_id`.

separate_from_memory.reason: task_records.jsonl is a physically separate file with a disjoint schema from memory_records.jsonl.

query_field.reason: Every sampled task record carries a non-empty `question` string.

gold_answer_field.reason: 0/300 sampled task records had `answer: null` -- every sampled record carried a non-null answer string.

task_id_field.reason: Every sampled task record carries a `task_id` field.

session_or_conversation_id.reason: Every sampled task record carries `conversation_id`, joinable to memory_records.jsonl.

evidence_availability.reason: 0/300 sampled task records had empty `evidence_memory_ids`; sampled records carry large gold-evidence-ID lists (one sampled record had 36 gold memory_ids), which is consistent with DATASET_CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md's framing of LongMemEval as stressing candidate-generation recall at scale. This is the single most important field for the Strict-TSR audit and is confirmed populated (with literal memory_id values, not just raw refs) in every sampled record.

answer_availability.reason: See workload_availability.gold_answer_field -- 0/300 sampled records had a null answer.

provenance_availability.reason: Sampled memory records carry a `provenance` object (conversation_id, session_id, source_dataset, source_file, source_record_id, turn_id, extraction_pipeline_version) -- the foundation-memory source pointer, not a derived-memory parent-edge structure.

lineage_availability.reason: No parent_ids edges exist anywhere in the file (whole-file grep, 0 matches); there is no lineage graph to walk.

equivalence_availability.reason: Whole-file grep of all 210365 lines for 'equivalent_to' returned zero matches.

temporal_information.reason: Sampled records carry `timestamp_type: "absolute"` with absolute date/time strings (e.g. '2023/04/10 (Mon) 17:50'), consistent with DATASET_CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md's 'Multi-session, timestamped, long-horizon' row for LongMemEval.

RECALL_AT_K.reason: Gold evidence_memory_ids are present and populated (0/300 empty in sample); at 210365 memory records, this dataset is specifically well-suited to stress-test Recall@K at higher corpus size per its DATASET_CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md role.

STRICT_TSR.reason: evidence_memory_ids are literal gold memory IDs in every sampled record -- exactly the strict_tsr() input.

SELECTION_COUNT.reason: No dataset-specific gold dependency; operates on any future selected_memory_ids sequence.

SELECTION_CAPACITY_DIAGNOSTICS.reason: Requires gold_id plus retrieved/selected id sequences; gold ids are present.

EVIDENCE_PRECISION.reason: evidence_memory_ids present and populated in every sampled record.

EVIDENCE_COVERAGE.reason: Same gold-ID basis; PROVISIONAL metric per metrics/README.md but computable with the data present.

IRRELEVANT_MEMORY_RATE.reason: Computable once a selection layer exists; gold ids are present for comparison.

REDUNDANCY.reason: Identity-duplicate-only redundancy needs only a selected-memory-id sequence, dataset-agnostic.

EQUIVALENCE_DIAGNOSTICS.reason: No explicit equivalent_to edges exist anywhere in the file (whole-file grep, 0 matches).

PROVENANCE_VALIDATION.reason: Sampled records carry a full `provenance` object; provenance validation does not require parent_ids for a foundation-only substrate.

LINEAGE_DIAGNOSTICS.reason: No parent_ids edges exist anywhere in the file (whole-file grep, 0 matches); no lineage graph exists to diagnose.

AGENT_ANSWER_CORRECTNESS.reason: Gold answers are present in every sampled record (0/300 null).

AGENT_SUCCESS.reason: Thin wrapper over answer correctness; same basis.

MEMORY_CONTRIBUTION.reason: Requires task_id + expected_answer + paired execution results under NO_MEMORY vs. WITH_MEMORY -- both gold answer and gold evidence are present to construct these once a real agent exists.

OBSERVED_GOLD_EVIDENCE_CEILING.reason: Requires GOLD_EVIDENCE-condition results plus expected answers, both constructible from populated answer/evidence_memory_ids fields.

RETRIEVAL_UTILIZATION.reason: No dataset-specific gold dependency beyond having a task; supported once execution results exist.

FAILURE_STAGE_CLASSIFICATION.reason: gold_evidence_ids and expected_answer are both present and populated in the sample; supported once execution results exist.

NO_MEMORY.reason: Needs only task_id/question, present for every task record.

GOLD_EVIDENCE.reason: Gold evidence CONTENT can be assembled from evidence_memory_ids -> memory_records.jsonl content lookup; every sampled task has a non-empty evidence_memory_ids list.

RETRIEVED_MEMORY.reason: Requires a real candidate-discovery/reranking/selection pipeline over 210365 memory records, which does not exist yet -- see adapter_requirements. This dataset's scale (largest of the four) makes candidate-generation recall the dominant expected stress point, per its DATASET_CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md role and the historical ~72.4% candidate-generation-failure finding in PHASE3_CLEAN_AGENT_FOUNDATION_SPEC.md section 3.

DERIVED_MEMORY_AVAILABLE.reason: No derived memories exist in the current substrate (no parent_ids anywhere).

CONFLICTING_MEMORY_AVAILABLE.reason: No conflicts_with edges exist anywhere in the file (whole-file grep, 0 matches).

adapter_requirements: A candidate-discovery + reranking + selection pipeline over data/processed/longmemeval/memory_records.jsonl (210365 records) -- not implemented anywhere yet; at this scale, candidate-discovery recall is the primary expected bottleneck per PHASE3_CLEAN_AGENT_FOUNDATION_SPEC.md section 3's historical finding.

A corpus-scale-aware evaluation harness capable of handling 210365 memory records per corpus (vs. LoCoMo's 5882) without assuming small-corpus performance characteristics; this profile only notes the scale difference, it does not build such a harness.
limitations: The full memory_records.jsonl (210365 lines) was never read record-by-record in this stage -- only a 500-line prefix sample plus a whole-file grep for four specific relationship field names. A different sample could surface edge cases (e.g. a null-evidence task, as observed for a small minority of LoCoMo tasks) not present in the sampled prefix.

data/metadata/dataset_manifest.json's known_limitations field notes that longmemeval_m_cleaned.json (~2.7GB) was never acquired in Phase 1 -- this profile inherits that scope limitation from the frozen Phase 1/2 substrate; it is documented here for completeness, not resolved.

Two LongMemEval memory records are flagged in data/metadata/longmemeval_provenance_exceptions.json as QUARANTINED (encoding-integrity-uncertain, not poisoning) -- this profile notes their existence but does not verify whether either falls inside the sampled prefix or any task's gold-evidence set; the exceptions file itself is Phase 2 read-only material and is not modified here.

evidence_notes.claim: memory_id is present, stable-looking, and unique in a 500-record sample.
Gold evidence memory IDs are present and populated (0/300 sampled empty) as literal memory_id lists, some quite large (36 ids observed in one sampled task).
Gold answers are present in every sampled record (0/300 null).
No memory record anywhere in the file declares parent_ids, equivalent_to, conflicts_with, or superseded_by.
evidence_notes.field: (whole-file grep for four literal field-name strings, 210365 lines)

evidence_notes.claim: Two records are flagged QUARANTINED for an unrelated encoding-integrity issue (not poisoning), per Phase 2's own case study.
